drafts.rationale: EV-K-A1, EV-K-A2, and EV-K-A3 all specify the same locus: how many original and retry delivery attempts a job may make.
drafts.subject: Delivery job

drafts.rationale: EV-K-B1 and EV-K-B2 both specify how long the worker must wait after a failed attempt before starting a retry.
drafts.subject: Delivery job

drafts.rationale: EV-K-N1 specifies what happens to a job after its last permitted attempt fails, including failed-state retention and operator review.
drafts.subject: Delivery job

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A1 states that each delivery job may make no more than three delivery attempts in total and that the first attempt is included in that limit.

value.text: No more than three delivery attempts in total, including the first attempt

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A2 and EV-K-A3 both state that a job has one original or initial delivery attempt and that, if it fails, no more than three retry attempts may follow.

value.text: One initial delivery attempt, then no more than three retry attempts after that initial attempt fails

drafts.rationale: EV-K-B1 states that before starting any retry attempt the worker waits five seconds after the preceding failed attempt.
EV-K-B2 states that retry waits are not fixed: two seconds before the first retry, then doubling, capped at thirty seconds.

value.text: Wait two seconds before the first retry; before each later retry double the previous wait, never more than thirty seconds

drafts.predicate: action after last permitted attempt fails
drafts.rationale: EV-K-N1 states that if a job has not succeeded after its last permitted attempt it remains failed for operator review and must not be automatically discarded.

value.text: Leave the job in failed state and require operator review; do not automatically discard the job
